qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the wiper shaft to tailgate window connection?
What torque value is specified for the wiper console to tailgate rubber mount?
What is the screw type and torque for the wiper motor to console connection?
qa_pairs.answer: E34 touring type, 13 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is given for the motor crank to wiper motor connection?
What is the torque value for the wiper arm to wiper shaft connection?
qa_pairs.answer: 13 Nm for E34/E36 Touring and E36 comp/touring models.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is required for the spray nozzle to tailgate connection?
Which component uses an M6 screw type according to the table?
qa_pairs.answer: The E36 comp/touring model uses an M6 screw with 10 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this tailgate window wiper information belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 61-6 General Electrical system, specifically section 61 62 Tailgate Window Wiper.

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for the tailgate window wiper components?
qa_pairs.answer: Four different torque values are specified: 5 Nm, 10 Nm, 13 Nm, and another 10 Nm entry.

qa_pairs.question: Which BMW model variants are covered in this tailgate window wiper specification table?
qa_pairs.answer: E34 touring, E36 comp/touring, E34/E36 Touring, and E36 comp/touring model variants are covered.
